short_description.raw: This opportunity sets up an Equestrian Training Academy inside public schools in the Riyadh region. It will build and run riding arenas, stables, and training programs for 250–400 trainees each year. Location: Al Iskan district, Riyadh city, on a site of more than 12,000 m², using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education. It is the first academy of its kind inside a public school, helping promote horse riding as part of Saudi heritage.

short_description.raw:
The project aims to establish a treatment facility for non-hazardous industrial waste across Yanbu cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of 
the overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would require a continuous input of non-
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors
The historic and projected growth in industrial 
sector as part of the KSA transformation requires 
innovative solutions for treatment of industrial 
waste
The drive to increase private sector participation 
and competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector 
in the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting 
investors and operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables the industrial waste operator 
to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's 
economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 13M USD*

Plant capacity: 46,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 19.56%

Payback period: 4.78 years

GDP Impact: 347M USD

Location (Region): Yanbu Cluster

short_description.raw:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Yanbu cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Yanbu Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Yanbu are additional demand 
drivers and are projected to increase in the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1M USD*

Plant capacity: 1,500 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.83 years

GDP Impact: 24M USD

Location (Region): Yanbu Cluster

Yanbu’s population is expected to continue to grow over the 
next few decades, which can potentially generate significant 
demand for the project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste 
treatment infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance 
while also offering attractive returns to potential investors

consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing

in waste treatment solutions

management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities

short_description.raw:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Taif cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to 
cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors. This 
opportunity also receives waste from other streams such as 
agricultural, healthcare and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial 
sector as part of the KSA transformation 
requires innovative solutions for treatment of 
hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector 
participation and competitiveness in the 
economy are further drivers for formulation of 
the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management 
sector in the Kingdom is a key driver to 
attracting investors and operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of Vision 
2030 the project enables a hazardous industrial waste operator to 
capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a greenfield 
project with no constraints from legacy infrastructure in a 
developing sector enabling a full use of best-in-class operational 
and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 26M USD*

Plant capacity: 21,241 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.67 years

GDP Impact: 138M USD


waste treatment solutions

can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities

short_description.raw:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Qunfudhah cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Al Qunfudhah Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Al Qunfudhah are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 0.5M USD*

Plant capacity: 1,300 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.84 years

GDP Impact: 23M USD

Location (Region): Al Qunfudhah Cluster

Al Qunfudhah’s population is expected to continue to grow 
over the next few decades, which can potentially generate 
significant demand for the project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste 
treatment infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance 
while also offering attractive returns to potential investors

short_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Al Qunfudhah cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline 
in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles 
from producers for processing and transfer along the further 
waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption 
etc.) are increasing vehicle consumption requiring 
uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities





short_description.raw:
The project aims to establish a treatment and disposal center for hazardous industrial waste across Qassim Cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of 
the overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors. 
This opportunity also receives waste from other streams 
such as agricultural, healthcare and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial 
sector as part of the KSA transformation requires 
innovative solutions for treatment of hazardous 
industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation 
and competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector 
in the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting 
investors and operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables a hazardous industrial waste 
operator to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's 
economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 530M USD*

Plant capacity: 746,941 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 7.09 years

GDP Impact: 3,082M USD

Location (Region): Qassim Cluster

and transfer operators in Najran Cluster

sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Najran are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

drivers for formulation of the opportunity

short_description.raw:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Northern Borders cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of 
the overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors. 
This opportunity also receives waste from other streams 
such as agricultural, healthcare and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector 
as part of the KSA transformation requires innovative 
solutions for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in 
the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables a hazardous industrial waste 
operator to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's 
economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 55M USD*

Plant capacity: 79,904 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.75 years

GDP Impact: 353M USD

Location (Region): Northern Borders Cluster

The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Northern Borders cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Northern Borders Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Northern Borders are 
additional demand drivers and are projected to 
increase in the future


competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity

short_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Northern Borders cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to 
decline in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life 
vehicles from producers for processing and transfer along the 
further waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift 
in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an 
attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities


Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline 
in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles 
from producers for processing and transfer along the further 
waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities

short_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Makkah Cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline 
in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles 
from producers for processing and transfer along the further 
waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities

short_description.raw:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Hafar Al Batin cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to 
cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of hazardous 
industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative 
solutions for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in the 
Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of Vision 2030 
the project enables a hazardous industrial waste operator to capitalize 
on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a greenfield project 
with no constraints from legacy infrastructure in a developing sector 
enabling a full use of best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 39M USD*

Plant capacity: 44,346 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.75 years

GDP Impact: 215M USD

Location (Region): Hafar Al Batin Cluster

The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Hafar Al Batin cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased to 2.6 
M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of USD 
12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 6.9% during 
the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical waste 
management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided from 
public and private healthcare providers and transported to the 
facilities through waste collection and transfer operators in 
Hafar Al Batin Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Hafar Al Batin are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in the 
future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity

The global industrial waste management market was valued at USD 
791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 10.4% from

value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the overall 
waste generated across the globe


industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative solutions 
for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in the 
Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators

M USD 


the project enables a hazardous industrial waste operator to capitalize 
on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's economy

with no constraints from legacy infrastructure in a developing sector 
enabling a full use of best-in-class operational and technical solutions

short_description.raw:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Jazan cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased to 
2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of USD 
12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 6.9% during 
the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical waste 
management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided from 
public and private healthcare providers and transported to the 
facilities through waste collection and transfer operators in 
Jazan Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare sector are 
increasing the demand for healthcare waste management 
services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and further 
expansion of Jazan are additional demand drivers and are 
projected to increase in the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD


Plant capacity: 4,300 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.80 years

GDP Impact: 44M USD

Location (Region): Jazan Cluster

Jazan’s population is expected to continue to grow over the next few 
decades, which can potentially generate significant demand for the 
project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste treatment 
infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance while also offering 
attractive returns to potential investors

solutions

sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities

short_description.raw:
The project aims to create a non-hazardous landfill mainly for municipal solid waste, throughout Jazan (Islands). 

Nowadays, modern landfill facilities are engineered with containment 
systems and monitoring programs.

In recent years, there has been a growing trend towards reducing the 
amount of waste sent to landfill and increasing the use of alternative 
waste management methods.

The main input to the operation comes from the Environmental 
Waste Treatment Centers (integrated facilities) for final 
disposal, which belongs to the municipal solid waste value 
chain.

Growth in Jazan’s population, personal incomes as well 
as continued transformation and increase in living 
standards are increasing the demand for waste 
management services

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 will require innovative, sustainable and 
scalable solutions to be deployed in Jazan Cluster

The project aims to establish a treatment facility for non-hazardous industrial waste, located in Dammam Governorate

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of 
the overall waste generated across the globe
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables the industrial waste operator 
to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's 
economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 63M USD*

Plant capacity: 200,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.82 years

GDP Impact: 1,071M USD

Location (Region): Dammam Cluster

The operation would require a continuous input of non-
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors
The historic and projected growth in industrial 
sector as part of the KSA transformation requires 
innovative solutions for treatment of industrial 
waste
The drive to increase private sector participation 
and competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector 
in the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting 
investors and operators

economy

greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of





hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors

sector as part of the KSA transformation requires

waste
The drive to increase private sector participation 
and competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity

in the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting

short_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Dammam Cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic drop, 
reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline in 2022, with 
a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) are 
increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and sustainable 
solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life vehicle 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR

Expected Investment size: 5MUSD*

Plant capacity: 25,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 20.79%

Payback period: 3.78 years

GDP Impact: 99M USD

Location (Region): Dammam Cluster

The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across AlBaha cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at USD 
791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 10.4% from 
2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to cross 
the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of hazardous 
industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative solutions 
for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in the 
Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of Vision 2030 
the project enables a hazardous industrial waste operator to capitalize 
on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a greenfield project 
with no constraints from legacy infrastructure in a developing sector 
enabling a full use of best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 8M USD*

Plant capacity: 6,836 tons of waste per year






The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Asir cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic drop, 
reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline in 2022, with 
a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, increasing 
personal consumption etc.) are increasing vehicle 
consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private sector 
participation require innovative, and sustainable solutions 
in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life vehicle 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities

short_description.raw:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Ahsa cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased to 2.6 
M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of USD 
12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 6.9% during 
the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical waste 
management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided from 
public and private healthcare providers and transported to the 
facilities through waste collection and transfer operators in Al 
Ahsa Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare sector are 
increasing the demand for healthcare waste management 
services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and further 
expansion of Al Ahsa are additional demand drivers and 
are projected to increase in the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1M USD*

Plant capacity: 3,500 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.83 years

GDP Impact: 40M USD

Location (Region): Al Ahsa Cluster

Al Ahsa’s population is expected to continue to grow over the next few 
decades, which can potentially generate significant demand for the 
project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste treatment 
infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance while also offering 
attractive returns to potential investors



waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption 
etc.) are increasing vehicle consumption requiring 
uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, 
and sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities

The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Al Kharaj cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of 
the overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors. 
This opportunity also receives waste from other streams 
such as agricultural, healthcare and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative solutions 
for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in the 
Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables a hazardous industrial waste 
operator to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's 
economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 443M USD*

Plant capacity: 717,443 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.78 years

GDP Impact: 2,850M USD


vehicles from producers for processing and transfer along the 
further waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption 
etc.) are increasing vehicle consumption 
requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation 
driven by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to 
increase private sector participation require 
innovative, and sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an 
attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities

The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Jouf cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Al Jouf Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Al Jouf are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity






GDP Impact: 25M USD

Location (Region): Al Jouf Cluster

Al Jouf’s population is expected to continue to grow over the 
next few decades, which can potentially generate significant 
demand for the project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste 
treatment infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance 
while also offering attractive returns to potential investors

short_description.raw:
The project is aiming to establish construction and demolition waste (CDW) treatment and final disposal operator, offering services in Al Baha

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Al Baha's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Due to continued growth in KSAs construction sector the 
project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 1.97M USD*

Plant capacity: 150,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 

Payback period: 6.93 years

GDP Impact: 32M USD


The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected

total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Yanbu's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions

short_description.raw:
The project is aiming to establish a fixed facility for construction and demolition waste (CDW) treatment, offering services in Najran
 

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Najran's population growth and expansion are 
the main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation

The increase in personal income and 
government incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the 
development of the infrastructure sector, which 
is expected to lead to an increase in waste 
generation necessitating further waste 
management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Due to continued growth in KSAs construction sector the 
project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 4.53M USD*

Plant capacity: 300,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 

Payback period: 6-8 years

GDP Impact: 95M USD

Location (Region): Najran

short_description.raw:
The project is aiming to establish a fixed facility for construction and demolition waste (CDW) treatment, offering services in Al Qassim
 

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Al Qassim's population growth and expansion 
are the main drivers of construction and 
demolition waste generation

The increase in personal income and 
government incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the 
development of the infrastructure sector, which 
is expected to lead to an increase in waste 
generation necessitating further waste 
management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Due to continued growth in KSAs construction sector the 
project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 4.53M USD*

Plant capacity: 300,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 

Payback period: 6-8 years

GDP Impact: 95M USD

Location (Region): Al Qassim

The project is aiming to establish a fixed facility for construction and demolition waste (CDW) treatment, offering 
services in Jeddah

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Jeddah's population growth and expansion are 
the main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation

The increase in personal income and 
government incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the 
development of the infrastructure sector, which 
is expected to lead to an increase in waste 
generation necessitating further waste 
management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Due to continued growth in KSAs construction sector the 
project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Project is expected to have a stable supply of input material, 
and a strong investment returns relative to peers in other 
geographies due to high number of construction projects 
expected in the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 5.33M USD*

Plant capacity: 600,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 

Payback period: 6-8 years

GDP Impact: 162M USD


•
Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and sustainability consulting 
market is estimated at SAR ~ 2.0 Billion and is expected to grow ~ 2.6x 
by 2030
•
Limited local coverage across emerging sectors such as hydrogen, 
renewable energy, mining, and advanced manufacturing
•
Local service providers’ expertise consists of mostly generalist, with 
limited specialization in specific EIA topics like air dispersion, water 
quality, wastewater, etc.
•
Upcoming spend of SAR ~3,4602 Bn and SAR ~5502 Bn in 
construction & manufacturing projects, respectively
•
NCEC has introduced EIA requirements for category 2 & 
3 projects as a prerequisite for obtaining project permits; 
this is expected to increase demand for EIA
•
Targeted growth of ~40% YoY in NCEC registered entities 
is expected to drive demand for env. services
•
Tadawul published environmental reporting guidelines 
for listed companies and PIF is increasingly reporting on 
sustainability across its entities
•
Market is in its evolving stage, with demand expected to grow at 14% 
YoY across the period 2024 – 2030
•
Over 110 of EIA service providers are currently available, however, they 
remain insufficient to cover the market demand
•
Sustainability consulting market is dominated by local players; 
however, most of the market value is captured by experienced 
international companies offering specialized services
•
Global Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) market is growing 
rapidly, primarily driven by stricter regulatory compliance, and growing 
environmental awareness 
•
Integration of advanced digital technologies, such as AI and machine 
learning, in assessment processes
•
Utilization of remote sensing technologies, including satellite surveying, 
drones, and GIS
•
Incorporation of social dimensions by engaging indigenous and local 
communities in assessments

short_description.raw:
The investment entails establishing a facility for the assembly of air quality monitoring equipment
•
Demand in KSA is estimated at SAR ~240 Mn, accounting for ~40% GCC 
demand and expected to grow 3x by 2030
•
Supply is ~ 100% imports dependent, with only two assemblers having 
limited utilization in KSA market 
•
In addition to the industrial market, presence of over 240 air 
monitoring stations drives demand through upgrades
•
Facility set up is supported by industrial zones providing access to 
facilities and utilities
•
Global air quality monitoring equipment market is growing at a CAGR 
of ~ 7%, driven by public and private sector initiatives to reduce air 
pollution 
•
Market is characterized by a mix of established multinational 
companies and specialized regional firms
•
Demand is rising for portable air quality monitors and comprehensive 
solutions that measure multiple pollutants simultaneously
•
Increasing integration of IoT sensors (e.g., CEMS) and ambient air 
quality systems into smart city infrastructure

short_description.raw: Murabba Makkah is aimed to be a mixed-use development with 5-star hotel and a commercial mall components.The land is located in Kakiyyah District, along Ibrahim Al-Khalil Road that directly connects with Haram at 5.5km at 15mins drive, 9km from Mina-Arafat, 3km from Thaur Cave and approx. 10km from Jeddah-Makkah Expressway.The site lies in the residential district of Kakiyyah and has access to all infrastructure utilities including Electricity, Sewerage, Road and Telecommunication network.The location is well connected with all major historical sites, major commercial malls and has abundance of public transport that makes commutation easy.

short_description.raw: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of mechanical seals for industrial equipment to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.Overall demand for mechanical seals in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated to be 19,000 units in 2017. Driven by upcoming energy projects by Saudi Aramco, SEC and SWCC, demand is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 6.1% to reach 30,300 units by 2025. Currently, KSA demand for mechanical seals for industrial equipment is addressed mainly domestically; however, the remaining 30% is addressed through imports, presenting a great opportunity for investors to localize production.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the larger regional market in the GCC. With a growing demand in the region for high-quality mechanical seals used in oil and gas, water and wastewater, and power projects, the demand in the rest of the GCC is expected to increase from 29,000 units in 2017 to 45,000 units by 2025.In addition to an increasing market demand, Saudi Arabia has competitive costs for materials, labor and logistics and offers funding and incentives to investors.The main focus of this opportunity is to establish a manufacturing facility for mechanical seals for industrial equipment.Manufacturing: establish mechanical seals manufacturing facility to fabricate seals components, the facility to include turning, boring, grooving, milling, drilling and tapping capabilitiesFinishing operations: establish workshops to deliver hard facing, grinding, lapping, polishing and welding capabilities in addition to advanced surface treatment proceduresHowever, additional opportunities for localization exist across the value chain of mechanical seals production. These opportunities include:Design: establish a design and engineering capabilitiesInput materials: establish local foundriesInstallation and maintenance: offer support services, including quality control, assembly, and installation servicesInstallation and maintenance: offer maintenance services and repair services for mechanical seals and installed base

short_description.raw: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of circuit breakers to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.The overall demand for circuit breakers in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated at USD 370 million in 2018. Driven by utilities, oil and gas and other manufacturing industries, KSA demand is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 4% to reach USD 439 million by 2022. In 2018, demand for circuit breakers is 60% for high voltage and 30% for low voltage and ~10% for medium voltage. The split is expected to remain relatively the same till 2022.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the large regional market in the GCC with expected increase in demand from USD 308 million in 2018 to USD 370 million by 2022.The focus of this opportunity is on final manufacturing and components manufacturing of circuit breakers. These opportunities entail:Components manufacturing: establish manufacturing facilities conductors, contacts, operating mechanism and enclosuresFinal manufacturing and testing: establish facilities for final manufacturing of low circuit breakersFinal manufacturing and testing: establish facilities for final manufacturing of medium voltage circuit breakersFinal manufacturing and testing: establish world scale testing facilities for (e.g., vacuum interrupter predictive testing)However, there are additional opportunities across the circuit breakers manufacturing value chain. Opportunities include:Design: custom design and engineer circuit breakers for low and medium voltage applications for Saudi customersInput materials: manufacture copper alloys to meet KSA's specifications

short_description.raw: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of gears for industrial machinery to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.The overall demand for industrial gears in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated at USD 97 million in 2017. Driven by the presence of several oil and gas manufacturing companies in the Kingdom, market size is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 3% to reach USD 121 million by 2025. The global gears market is dominated by spur gears and bevel gears, having 50-80% market share.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the wider regional market of the GCC. With many companies in the GCC establishing extraction and production plants, demand for gears in the region has been increasing and is expected to continue to increase from USD 106 million in 2017 to USD 151 million by 2025.The main focus of this opportunity is to establish a manufacturing facility for industrial gears.Manufacturing: establish outsourced services offering heat treatment, machining…Manufacturing: establish facilities to produce locally and supply manufacturing facilitiesHowever, additional opportunities for localization exist across the value chain of industrial gears production. These opportunities include:Design: potential to be part of a larger design center setup by the EPC or the OEMRaw materials: localize production of key materials such as PEEK, Delrin, brass, etc.Operations and maintenance: offer support services, including maintenance, installation and operation services

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Description of Investment Opportunity
Rua Al Madinah Holding, a PIF company, is a key driver in developing infrastructure and assets that enhance Madinah’s position as a premier destination with a contemporary architectural landscape.

As part of this mandate, Rua Al Madinah Holding is offering investment opportunities in three upscale hotel towers and four upscale commercial towers, located within the Dar Al Hijrah project, a landmark mixed-use urban development in the holy city of Madinah, Saudi Arabia.

 

Deal Structure

Flexible deal structures are available, with multiple partnership models such as joint ventures, real estate funds, investment consortia and land or building leases

Assets Under Consideration

Hotel Towers (Shell & Core)

Opportunity 1: ~380 keys, BUA +40,300 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Opportunity 2: ~380 keys, BUA +40,300 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Opportunity 3: ~614 keys, BUA ≈70,000 sqm, 2 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Commercial (Office) Towers (Shell & Core)

Opportunity 4: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +10,650 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 5: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +9,500 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 6: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +13,380 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 7: BUA +56,300 sqm, land +8,850 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 16 floors
Investor Participation

Investors may participate in one or more of these opportunities Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg To be updated /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg 30 million visitors
Umrah visitors annually by 2030 Strategic Benefits Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers Vision 2030 alignment: Part of the national strategic development of Madinah, focusing on hospitality and tourism growth Accelerated time-to-market: Properties are partially completed, leading to short time-to-market and early recovery of investment cost High demand resilience: Madinah’s hospitality sector is known for consistent, year-round demand driven by religious tourism

The opportunity aims to meet rising demand for high-efficacy therapeutic interventions in complex and chronic conditions. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg To be updated /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg To be updated Strategic Benefits • Enable access to next-generation, personalized treatments for chronic and genetic conditions.
• Strengthen domestic innovation and manufacturing in high-value, cell-based therapeutics. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers • Rising demand for regenerative medicine due to increased cases of cancer and genetic disorders. • Government initiatives promoting localization of advanced biotech and cell therapy platforms.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity This opportunity involves setting up manufacturing facilities for biologic drugs in Saudi Arabia. Biologics are advanced therapies derived from living organisms, used to treat complex diseases such as cancer, autoimmune conditions, and rare disorders. Localizing production enhances healthcare innovation, quality of care, and biopharma sector competitiveness. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg To be updated /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg To be updated Strategic Benefits • Accelerate the development of high-value biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
• Support healthcare innovation and access to advanced therapies.
• Reduce dependence on costly biologic imports. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers • Rising demand for biologics in oncology and autoimmune disease management. • Global shift toward precision medicine and advanced therapies. • Government support for high-tech pharma investment. • Strategic potential for regional leadership in biologics manufacturing.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity This opportunity seeks to localize the production of Key Starting Materials (KSMs), which are the essential building blocks in the production of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs). It is a foundational investment that strengthens the upstream pharmaceutical supply chain, reduces dependency on imports, and contributes to long-term national health security. short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Develop a Saudi-based aviation lubricant production facility to reduce reliance on imports.

 Partner with APSCO, ExxonMobil, and Aramco/Luberef to leverage global expertise and local manufacturing capabilities.

 Target a guaranteed domestic market (airlines, MROs, military aviation) and explore export opportunities in GCC & MENA.

 Enhance Saudi Arabia’s supply chain resilience by ensuring a stable, cost-effective lubricant supply.

Support Vision 2030 localization goals by reducing financial leakage and creating local jobs.

This Opportunity reduces financial leakage, enhances supply chain security, and creates a new industrial sector in Saudi Arabia. By localizing aviation lubricant production, this project can drive economic growth, reduce costs for airlines, and position Saudi Arabia as a regional hub for aviation lubricants.
Vision 2030 and the National Aviation Strategy set an ambitious target for the sector to grow from 100 Mn pax in 2019 to 330 Mn pax by 2030 Key opportunity characteristics Strategic Benefits • Currently there are no local assembly Aviation lubricant relying on international imports from one sources ( Exxon Mobile Texas plant)
• RTGs; potential to replace KSA imports Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers Cost Efficiency – Reduce import costs, shipping fees, and foreign currency risks. Operational Security – Ensure uninterrupted lubricant availability for commercial & military aviation. Economic Impact – Create local jobs, develop industrial expertise, and drive investment. Supply Chain Optimization – Eliminate logistics bottlenecks & price volatility. Sustainability & ESG Alignment – Support green aviation initiatives with localized, optimized production. KSA aviation sector to grow from 100Mn pax in 2019 to 330 Mn pax by 2030 KSA airlines’ fleet to grow from 250 aircrafts to 500 aircrafts Substantial regional demand from a strong aviation sector  Active players (non-exhaustive): International players: Exxon Mobile, Local Players: Apsco – Lubref/Aramco

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity OPDC is seeking private sector investment and operational expertise to either JV or develop and manage a comprehensive range of water sports activities at THE RIG Project, a flagship tourism destination in Saudi Arabia. This opportunity allows private operators to provide services and equipment for various water sports while partnering with OPDC under a rent plus profit-sharing model. 

Products/services covered
- The opportunity targets a wide range of water sports and related services, including but not limited to:
- Adventure Water Sports: Kite surfing, surfing, jet skiing, e-foil rides, and motorized water sports.
- Recreational Water Sports: Diving, parasailing, snorkeling, and stand-up paddle boarding.
- Training Services: Professional lessons and certification for water sports enthusiasts.
- Rental Services: Equipment rentals for guests interested in independent water sport activities.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Investment in equipment and materials for water sports (e.g., jet skis, diving equipment, kite-boards).
- Recruitment and training of skilled personnel for operations and guest safety.
- Setting up operational hubs and storage facilities at “THE RIG”.

Midstream
- Service delivery, including providing water sports experiences, training, and rentals.
- Integration with “THE RIG’s” broader tourism offerings to enhance guest experiences.
- Adherence to OPDC’s standards for sustainability and safety.

Focus Area
- The opportunity is focused on offering a world-class, diverse water sports experience that complements the luxury tourism offerings at "THE RIG" Key opportunity characteristics Strategic Benefits • A unique opportunity to partner with a global tourism icon, a luxury, adventure-focused environment and become a vital part of the region's tourism evolution.
• OPDC is offering a lucrative rent plus profit-sharing model, enabling private sector players to generate consistent revenue without the need for significant upfront infrastructure investment. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia Adventure Tourism Market: Growing at 8-12% YoY. - GCC Water Sports Market: Growing at 6-8% YoY.  Mega Projects Boom – Government support tourism - High Demand for Experiences - Tourists are shifting towards unique, adrenaline-filled activities, creating demand for water sports such as kite surfing, e-foil, parasailing, and diving.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity The Rua Al Haram development project presents a strategic investment opportunity for private investors to participate in the design, construction, and operation of logistics and labor accommodation facilities critical to the success of this large-scale, multi-phase development. These facilities will play a pivotal role in supporting the project's construction and operational activities, addressing workforce housing, material handling, and overall construction logistics.

Based on the current forecast (subject to change) of daily labor personnel numbers, the labor accommodation would have the following key characteristics:

- Land  – The land required is based upon 3-story residential buildings = 300m.sq x 600m.sq = 180,000 m.sq land area.
- Capacity required – The employee residential facilities would be required for ~ 5,000 employees consisting of:
      - 1 Bedroom (40 sq. m per room) – 8
      - 1 Bedroom (20m.sq per room) – 112
      - 2 Bed per room (20m.sq per room) – 280
      - 4 beds per room (24m.sq per room) – 1080

- Additional facilities include kitchens, dining, recreation, sport, laundry, admin, security, medical, retail, fire station, swimming pools, parking, and utilities. Additionally, other facilities, such as - compounds for contractors, consultants' offices, warehouses, off-site manufacturing, etc. (typically requiring ∼1,500 m.sq. for 200 people.

This opportunity targets essential infrastructure and operational services, including worker housing, transportation, material storage, batching plants, construction logistics, and security systems. These offerings are critical to supporting the smooth execution of the Rua Al Haram project and ensuring its timely delivery. They also create long-term value for investors through sustained demand and operational scalability. Key opportunity characteristics Strategic Benefits • This opportunity offers strategic alignment with national priorities, financially lucrative revenue streams, and the chance to play a central role in one of the region's most significant urban development projects. By addressing critical project needs for logistics and labor accommodations, investors can secure a high-impact, low-risk position in a transformative initiative with long-term growth potential.
• The strategic benefits of this opportunity are rooted in the scale and complexity of the Rua Al Haram project, regional development priorities under Vision 2030, and technological and operational advancements that enhance efficiency and scalability. These benefits ensure sustained demand, long-term profitability, and expansion opportunities. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Rua Al Haram represents the region's unparalleled urban development initiative, setting a new benchmark for scale and ambition. Its portfolio comprises of hotel guest rooms, residential units, commercial space, and prayer areas. - The project is expected to require a workforce of significant scale, reaching over 100,000 workers at peak construction.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity KAFD has evolved to become a prime business and lifestyle destination capturing the core values of Vision 2030. KAFD empowers businesses through access to advanced office infrastructure and sustainable smart city solutions, while simultaneously offering unique lifestyle experiences with leading leisure and retail facilities. This opportunity focuses on residential assets for KAFD Area 7.

Deal Structure:
Joint venture future development  partnership

Assets Under Consideration:
Residential apartment products of a premium, luxury and branded nature. 
- Branded Residential Tower Parcels: 2 properties (354 units)
- Residential Tower Parcels: 4 properties (985 units) Key opportunity characteristics Strategic Benefits • KAFD offers a world-class mixed use development and is the Financial and Business Center of Riyadh. This component will offer luxury and premium residential to the working population of KAFD’s offices as well as a spectrum of investors who wish to own property in the heart of the city. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - The opportunity targets the executive level employees of KAFD’s Grade A Office market and HNWI who wish to invest or keep residence adjacent to the Financial Center. - Strategic Location - Strategically located at the center of Riyadh and accessible via three main access points, including Northern Ring Road, King Fahd Road and Thumama Road. KAFD is also a strategic component of the Public Transport system with its Metro Station a central connection point for the three main lines of Riyadh City.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Northern Community 3 is a premium mixed-use district featuring high-end residential, Grade-A commercial offices, and vibrant retail offerings.

It aims to foster a vibrant urban community that targets affluent professionals, executives, and families seeking a connected, modern urban lifestyle.

Deal Structure 
- Land sale
 
Assets Under Consideration
- Residential apartments – 1,800 units with 80,000 sqm. land take and 180,000 sqm gross floor area (GFA)
- Commercial offices – Grade A offices with 20,000 sqm. land take and 50,000 sqm (GFA)
- Retail – 3,000 sqm. land take and 6,000 sqm (GFA) Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg 50 million visitors
[Expected by 2030] Strategic Benefits • Diriyah – The City of Earth – has traditional Najdi architecture and offers a diverse hospitality offering across lifestyle, and luxury, branded residences to meet the needs of a broad spectrum of visitors. short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Description of Investment Opportunity
NEOM aims to become the world’s first 100% renewable electricity system with energy generation based mainly on solar. Energy storage is required to store excess solar energy during the day and release it at night. Pumped Hydro Storage (PHS) is the most mature and cost competitive storage available. Waterways and powerhouse to be located completely underground to improve land conservation, durability and aesthetics.

 

Deal Structure:
The project is envisioned to be structured as a Build–Own–Operate–Transfer (“BOOT”) in accordance with best industry practices
Time schedule assumes commercial and financial close in Q3 2025 and first energy in Q4 2029

Technical Considerations: 
- Installed capacity  – 2.2 GW
- Generation max power – 2.1 GW
- Storage capacity – 23.1 GWh
- Time constant in turbine mode – 11 hours
- Round trip efficiency – 80% Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 12.4B (USD 3.3B) Strategic Benefits • PHS shall become an iconic piece of energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia
• Robust contractual structure in line with best international practices
• Stable and predictable cash-flows, credit support and risk allocation will ensure bankability of the project Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - NEOM aims to create the world’s first 100% renewable energy system, underpinning demand for long-term energy storage. PHS will be the first of several PHS facilities at NEOM

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Jeddah Central Development Company is seeking a qualified private sector investor interested in partnering to finance the Oceanarium. The company is exploring different private sector participants.

A world-class oceanarium and coral farm, as well as a maritime research hub, situated along the coastal area of Jeddah. Designed by SOM from the United States the facility will feature seven pavilions (Shoreline and Mangrove, Coral Reef, The Vortex, Depth of the Red Sea, Back to the Shore, Restoration & Production of a Reef, and Technology & Products from the Red Sea) aimed at enhancing visitors' experience. The total land area is 43,924 m2, total Gross Floor Area (GFA) is nearly 21,076 m2, with an average capacity of 2,500 persons. 

The Oceanarium is situated at the Jeddah Center destination project, the heart of Jeddah, Saudi Arabia’s second-largest city, and gateway to Mekkah. Spanning an impressive 5.7 million m2, with 9.5 km of coastline. Jeddah Central is set to become a global waterfront destination with extensive mixed-use assets, including hospitality, retail, commercial, and residential properties, and key landmarks. The project is positioned as a leading tourist destination, aiming to preserve Jeddah’s rich culture while revitalizing the downtown area. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1.86B (USD 0.5B) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg 8 millions visitors
[Projected by 2030] Strategic Benefits • Investing in an income-generating asset under a PPP structure.
• Playing a part in financing an environment-friendly—including promoting biodiversity—a social asset with a positive social and environmental impact.
• Diversifying the investment portfolio.
• Fostering trust and collaboration with a leading PIF-owned portfolio company. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers Admission revenue, event space for corporates in coffee and gift shops, superb restaurants, VIP suites, rentals in glass-bottom kayaks, rentals in upcharge experiences (including tours, animal interactions, and sea trek helmet diving), and sponsorships are the seven largest revenue drivers, accounting for over 90% of total revenue.

full_description.canonical_label: Description of Investment Opportunity Jeddah Central Development Company is seeking a qualified private sector investor interested in partnering to finance the Oceanarium. The company is exploring different private sector participants. A world-class oceanarium and coral farm, as well as a maritime research hub, situated along the coastal area of Jeddah. Designed by SOM from the United States the facility will feature seven pavilions (Shoreline and Mangrove, Coral Reef, The Vortex, Depth of the Red Sea, Back to the Shore, Restoration & Production of a Reef, and Technology & Products from the Red Sea) aimed at enhancing visitors' experience. The total land area is 43,924 m2, total Gross Floor Area (GFA) is nearly 21,076 m2, with an average capacity of 2,500 persons. The Oceanarium is situated at the Jeddah Center destination project, the heart of Jeddah, Saudi Arabia’s second-largest city, and gateway to Mekkah. Jeddah Central is set to become a global waterfront destination with extensive mixed-use assets, including hospitality, retail, commercial, and residential properties, and key landmarks. short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establish a facility to localize traction motor packing and winding.

Streamline the production and maintenance of traction motors, reduce lead times, and enhance control over quality assurance. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 150-200M (USD 40-53.3M)
[For plant capacity of ca 400 traction motors/ annum] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ​SAR 600 – 700M (USD 160-186.7M)
[Projected for 2024-2030 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Saudi Arabia currently sends ca 400 traction motors annually outside the country for packing and winding
• No local capabilities in the region (mostly Europe-based)
• Demand for packing and winding is expected to grow across the region, resulting in significant service export potential Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by 2.5x (to 13,000 km of track) and increase its freight volumes by 8x by 2030, which results in increasing number of traction motors, leading to increase in packing and winding - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g. Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network)

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more excavators and loaders assembly plants to address the local supply gap of 12,800-16,200 units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of excavator and loader units with Stage V diesel engines
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 350-400M (USD 93.3-106.7M)
[For a facility of 1,500 units per year, excluding land] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 122B (~USD 32.5B)
Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia Strategic Benefits • Export potential to the Middle Eastern and African market, given absence of assembly facilities in the region
• Advantage over other OEMs owing to customers’ preference for locally produced units for better demand responsiveness
• Opportunity to be an anchor investment in the heavy machinery production sector in one of the most promising and fastest-growing markets in the world Current Market Characteristics • Consolidated supply landscape with five global OEMs – Caterpillar (US), Komatsu (Japan), Hyundai-Doosan (South Korea), Volvo (Sweden), and XCMG (China) – holding 75-80% market share
• Each OEM has exclusive local dealerships in Saudi Arabia for sales, distribution, and product support
• Saudi Arabia currently has no assembly facility; the local dealers import fully built-up units
• China, South Korea, India, Japan, and the US account for more than 90% of the imports (by value) Key Growth Drivers - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more chillers assembly plants  to address the local supply gap of ~15,000 units/annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of air-cooled and water-cooled chillers
- Inclusion of capabilities and equipment to assemble supply chain components (e.g., water cooling towers for water-cooled chillers)
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 300-350M (USD 80-93.3M)
[For a facility of 4K chillers and 1K water-cooling towers per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 135B (USD 36B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to replace imports of chillers and water-cooling towers
• Local availability of raw materials and components such as metal plates and heat exchangers
• Advantage over other OEMs owing to customers’ preference for locally produced units for better demand and maintenance responsiveness
• Large facilities will help achieving high EBITDA margins and low payback periods of ~5 years Current Market Characteristics • 3 local players supplying less than 10% of the local demand
• Key local players
• Johnson Controls, Zamil AC and Global Cooling Tower Factory

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Establishing of one or more marble cutting factories to address the local supply gap of 7.9-10.2M sqm per annum
- Cutting of marble blocks to slabs for applications in the interiors of residential, hospitality, and commercial real estate developments Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 130-170M (USD 34.7-45.3M)
[For a facility of 6M sqm per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 142B (USD 37.9B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to fill a gap in local supply chain as currently, no local players involved in cutting marble blocks to slabs
• Opportunity to gain a competitive edge as locally cut slabs of premium marble blocks imported from countries such as Italy and Spain will be more price competitive than slabs imported from the same countries
• Large facility with significant volumes will help achieve attractive EBITDA margins of 18-25% and rapid payback
• Current Market
• Characteristics
• Consolidated market with five local suppliers serving ~85% of the market; only slab cutting, and installation step is localized in Saudi Arabia
• All marble demand is met through imports because Saudi Arabia has limited marble reserves
• Oman, Italy, Egypt, and China account for more than two-thirds of the imports to Saudi Arabia
• All local players currently import marble in the form of slabs Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative national demand of ~145M sqm of marble for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
