Description of Investment Opportunity - Establish tower crane / overhead crane / construction hoist component manufacturing + assembly facility to address the local supply gap of ~19,000 cranes and ~70,000 hoists
- Products / Services Targeted: Assembly of cranes / hoists and manufacturing of components Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 177B (~USD 47.2B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Locally manufactured units could be cost-competitive vs. imports (up to 15-25% less expensive to produce vs. Europe1) and more tailored to Saudi context (e.g., more resistant to Saudi Arabia weather); partnering required for safety, certification and brand recognition considerations
• Know-how required to manufacture crane elements (i.e., structure, drum and rope guide) available in Saudi Arabia
• Current Market
• Tower/Overhead cranes and hoists are currently 100% imported as SKD and then assembled with locally produced frames Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative national demand ~0.3M cranes and ~1.2M hoists for the 2025-2040 period

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more ethylene tetrafluoroethylene (ETFE) foils production plants to address the local supply gap of 2-3M sqm per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Polymerization of monomers to form ETFE polymer and subsequent pelletization for easy transport for further processing
- Extrusion of ETFE foils from pelletized ETFE Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 60-80M (USD 16-21.3M)
[For a facility of 50K sqm per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 17B (~USD 4.5B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to become a regional champion in the GCC market, in the absence of any existing player in the region
• Abundant local availability of ethylene, one of the primary monomers of ETFE, at globally cost-competitive prices
• Additional demand from the pharma industry as a biocompatible material for packaging Current Market Characteristics • A few global players from US, Europe, and Asia dominate the ETFE polymer granulate and foil extrusion market; there are no players from GCC
• Local suppliers of input material
• Ethylene, one of the primary monomers of ETFE, is available locally from SABIC and Tasnee Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative national demand ~40M sqm of ETFE foils for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more ceramic sanitary ware manufacturing plants to address the local supply gap of 13-17M units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Production of mid-range and premium sanitary ware products across a wide product range (water closets, wash basins, bathtubs) 
- Full automation of production lines to ensure high-quality finishing Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 250-300M (USD 66.7-80M)
[For a facility of 2.5M units per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 221B (~USD 58.9B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to replace imported premium, super-premium, and mid-range sanitary ware products
• Local availability of key raw materials (kaolin, ball clay, feldspar, and silica, as well as gypsum and resin used for making the molds)
• Cost competitiveness of local production due to lower logistics cost and avoidance of 12% import tariffs
• Current Market
• Mid-range and premium segments together make up ~60% of the market
• Local players Saudi Ceramics, Al Forsan, Porsalina, Casa Via cater to basic and a small part of mid-range segment
• Global brands such as Kohler (USA), Roca (Spain), Geberit (Switzerland), RAK Ceramics (UAE) serve mid-range and entire premium segment
• Local suppliers of input materials
• Imerys (kaolin, ball clay), Gulf Sands (silica), Saudi Ceramics (feldspar) Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative demand of ~380M units of ceramic sanitary ware in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period; mid-range and premium segments’ market share to grow, at the expense of the basic segment - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Establishing one or more aluminum extrusion lines to address the local supply gap of 100,000 - 140,000  tons per annum
- Extrusion of aluminum billets into profiles for aluminum windows (insulated and non-insulated) to cater to a large proportion of upcoming local demand (~21M units cumulative from 2025 to 2040) Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 75-100M (USD 20-26.7M)
[For a facility of 25 ktpa capacity, excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 38B (~USD 10.1B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Local availability of aluminum billets through Ma’aden
• Export potential to MENA countries given imports of ~105k tons in 2021 for top five regional importers
• Potential for expansion to adjacent markets (e.g., aerospace and defense, automotive – target to produce 300,000 cars annually in Saudi Arabia by 2030) Current Market Characteristics • Market dominated by three large players
• Market supplied through local production and through imports (mainly from Bahrain)
• Key players include Alupco (local), Talco (local), Al Andalous (local) and Balexco (UAE)
• Local suppliers of input materials
• Maaden (aluminum billets) Key Growth Drivers - Construction demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia - Further demand impetus with growth of downstream industries (e.g., automotive, aerospace and defense)

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more facilities to manufacture spare components of excavators and loaders (buckets, accessories, cylinders, radiators, hydraulic hoses, track pads, and adjusters) to address the local supply gap of 300,000-390,000 tons per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Focus on catering to the spare parts market for post-warranty units (average post-warranty fleet size is ~48,000 units from 2023 to 2030)
- Future expansion potential to spares of other steel-based components (e.g., book, arm) Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 20-25M (USD 5.3-6.7M)
[For a facility of 25,000 - 30,000 tons capacity, excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 38B (~USD 10.1B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Growing demand for third-party spares as OEM manufactured spare parts are priced 20-30% higher and often have long lead time of one-to-three months
• Local availability of raw materials (steel)
• Cost advantage over imported spares, which attract a tariff of 10-15%
• Limited manufacturers of components for excavators and loaders in the GCC; proximity to the markets with better pricing and lead times than those of OEMs will enhance competitiveness
• Current Market
• New equipment come with a one-to-two-year warranty during which OEM dealers offer servicing with OEM spare parts
• Post warranty customers are open to using third-party spares, primarily due to cost competitiveness
• Currently, the OEM dealers supply spares to the majority of the market even post warranty due to limited availability of locally manufactured third-party spares Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative demand of ~SAR 38B for spares of buckets, accessories, cylinders, radiators, hydraulic hoses, track pads, and adjusters in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more EIFS production plants to address the local supply gap of 4-6M sqm per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Production of key elements of EIFS such as insulation boards and reinforcement mesh
- Installation of the system on-site, including attaching insulation boards, applying base coat, embedding reinforcement mesh, and applying finish coat
- Inclusion of capabilities to fabricate EIFS in off-site factories Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 30-45M (USD 8-12M)
[For a facility of 200K sqm per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 9B (~USD 2.4B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to capture a rapidly growing market due to the increased regulatory push for higher energy efficiency in construction
• Abundant local availability of key raw materials such as acrylic, polystyrene, resins, and glass fiber
• Opportunity to export to the wider GCC region, given limited regional manufacturers, and high dependence on imports Current Market Characteristics • Market supplied primarily by global players from Europe, Asia, and Americas; Terraco (UAE) is the only major player in GCC
• Industrial Polystone Factory is the only local player; with capacity of less than 1% of the expected demand
• Local suppliers of input material
• Tasnee (acrylic), Sappco (polystyrene), Saudi Industrial Resins Limited (resins), Glass Fiber Technology Co. (fiberglass) Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative national demand of ~81M sqm of EIFS for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity OPDC's THE RIG. project offers an opportunity for the private sector to propose innovative and sustainable mass mobility solutions for transporting visitors from onshore terminals to THE RIG. destination. This project spans 30 years, with the possibility of the operating model being based on a long-term lease or an operational management model.

The focus is on offering safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions, including options such as electric, hybrid, and cutting-edge technologies like sea gliders or hovercraft.

Products/services covered
The primary services targeted by this opportunity are transportation and mobility solutions for visitors. The focus is on providing a mass transit system that ensures safe, efficient, and comfortable transportation between onshore terminals and offshore on THE RIG. destination. The products or services could include
 - Electric or hybrid-powered transport options.
- Innovative transportation technologies (e.g., sea gliders, hovercraft).
- Long-term operational leasing or management services.
- Maintenance and safety assurance services for transportation solutions.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Design and Development
- The development and design of transportation solutions (e.g., electric/hybrid vehicles, sea gliders, hovercraft).

Manufacturing
- The production of transportation solutions, including any customization needed for offshore travel.

Operations
- Managing the transportation of visitors on a daily basis, including crew operations, maintenance, and safety management. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1B (USD 0.3B) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1.1B (USD 0.3B) Strategic Benefits • Tourism Development
• The project enhances the tourism sector, contributing to KSA’s ambition to become a leading global tourist destination. THE RIG project will likely attract significant numbers of international visitors, making efficient mass mobility solutions essential.
• Technological Leadership
• The opportunity allows for the integration of cutting-edge mobility technologies such as sea gliders and hovercraft, reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a leader in innovative and advanced transport systems.
• Long-Term Revenue Generation
• With a 30-year span and the potential for long-term leases or operation models, the project offers significant financial returns, making it an attractive investment for the private sector. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Tourism Sector Growth: Projected YoY growth of 7-8% through 2030. - The GCC region is expected to see a YoY growth of 5-7% in tourism.  Government Initiatives and Investments  Technological Innovations in Mobility - Innovations like electric, hybrid, and autonomous transportation systems.

Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists to build on Ma’aden’s high level of imports and establish a manufacturing plant for aluminum fluoride in Saudi Arabia.

- Application: Fluoride is a highly reactive and corrosive chemical element that is used in the mining industry for various purposes. This is primarily used in the production of aluminum.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Fluoride). Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 393M (USD 104.8M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 167M (USD 44.5M)
[Projected for 2024 - 2028] Strategic Benefits • Aluminum smelting capacity expected to increase in short-medium term, creating further demand.
• Demand for aluminum fluoride mainly dependent on production of aluminum metal and therefore driven by increase in downstream production of aluminum.
• Easy access to local customer base (Ma’aden has significant demand for aluminum fluoride and is currently fully dependent on imports). Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - In 2018, Saudi Arabia imported 9KT of aluminum fluoride, representing 100% of its local demand.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity SIRC subsidiary AKAM seeks a joint venture partner to establish, operate, and manage a state-of-the-art Construction and Demolition Waste (CDW) recycling facility in Saudi Arabia. This joint venture (JV) aims to transform CDW into valuable products, driving environmental sustainability and contributing to economic diversification.

Targeted Products
The recycling facility will focus on producing:
- Recycled aggregates.
- Sand.
- Other marketable materials derived from CDW.
 
Value Chain Activities
The JV will cover:
- Facility design and engineering.
- Construction and commissioning.
- Processing and recycling operations.
- Quality assurance and compliance.
- Sales and distribution of recycled products. short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity OPDC is seeking private sector investment to develop and supply electricity for THE RIG. project, a flagship tourism destination in Saudi Arabia. The opportunity involves designing, financing, building, operating, and transferring (BOT) a power generation and/or distribution system to meet the high-energy demands of the project. The BOT model ensures a long-term partnership with private investors for a contract period of 30 years or more.

Products/services covered

Primary Service
- Reliable electricity generation and distribution tailored to the needs of THE RIG.

Target Solutions
Renewable energy options, hybrid power systems, or conventional energy generation solutions. Secondary Services: Maintenance, operation, and management of the power infrastructure for the duration of the BOT contract.

 Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Investment and financing by private sector players.

Midstream
- Development, installation, and commissioning of power generation and distribution infrastructure.

Downstream
- Ongoing operation, maintenance, and delivery of electricity to meet THE RIG.'s energy requirements.

Focus Area
The opportunity is primarily concentrated on establishing a sustainable and efficient energy supply chain that ensures operational reliability for THE RIG. while leveraging private sector expertise and capital. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 100M (USD 26.7M)
[annually] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1B (USD 0.3B) Strategic Benefits Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia's electricity demand has been growing at an annual rate of 3-5% YoY. - The GCC’s electricity market is expected to grow by 2-4% YoY.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description An opportunity exists to develop local capabilities for recycling Aluminum scrap.

- Application: Aluminum  scrap is recyclable materials from post manufacturing processes or consumption. Applications include reuse in aluminum  production. The process involves simply re-melting the metal, which is far less expensive and energy intensive than producing new aluminum  from Bauxite Ore.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals - aluminum  7602 Scrap – Mixed, Ext, Coated (UBC), 1st Quality. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 260M (USD 69.3M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 2.06B (USD 0.5B)
[Projected for 2024 - 2028] Strategic Benefits • Globally, aluminum is one of the most profitable materials to recycle and has achieved higher recycling rates due to government’s focus on energy saving, reducing wastage.
• Quality: Concerns around the quality of aluminum scrap – Ma’aden requires aluminum 7602 Scrap – Mixed, Ext, Coated (UBC), 1st Quality. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - The global aluminum scrap recycling market size is estimated to grow at a significant CAGR of 8.9% during the forecast period 2022-2027. - 52 % (625 KMT) of total scrap generated in GCC countries is exported without being processed. - Diverse supply market, as aluminum scrap can come from a multitude of sources.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists to establish local manufacturing facility with a capacity of 250 ktpa for petroleum coke.

- Application: Petroleum coke is a carbon-rich solid material that is produced during oil refining. In its raw form it is known as Green Petroleum Coke (GPC). It is used for carbon anode manufacturing in aluminum smelters

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Petroleum Coke). Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 375-450M (USD 100-120M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 2.8B (USD 0.7B)
[Projected for 2024 - 2028] Strategic Benefits • Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC) offers good potential with favorable logistics to export to rest of the leading MENA aluminum smelters and steel plants – very large amount of foreign spend to be localized.
• Saudi Arabia has proximity to raw material (Green Petroleum Coke) sources, including UAE and Oman – increasing investment opportunity.
• Ma’aden have agreed a major deal signed from 2025 onwards to purchase Pet Coke locally from new facility in Saudi Arabia. Despite this agreement, there is still significant opportunity to build on local capability within Saudi Arabia. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - First mover advantages due to lack of established capacity in Saudi Arabia. - Ma’aden Aluminum would be the primary buyer within Saudi Arabia. - Saudi Arabia’s geographical advantage and trade agreements with neighboring countries make exporting favorable.

1. Setting up a smart water meters manufacturing plant.
2. Setting up a smart water meter component manufacturing plant to cater to water sector requirements across the local and regional markets. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg Approx. SAR 200-250M (~USD 53.3-66.7M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 297M (USD 79.2M)
[Forecasted up to 2030] Strategic Benefits • High potential of localization of meter manufacturing as local sourcing of key component and material is available in KSA. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia water meter expected to grow by ~8% CAGR until 2030 primarily driven by shift towards smart water meter. - Increased rate of home ownership (70% targeted by 2030) would spur demand for water meter connections. - Additional 1.9 m connections of water and wastewater connections driving the need for smart water meters. - Replacement of conventional meters with smart water meter. - Projects such as NEOM, the Red Sea Project, Qiddiya Entertainment City, King Abdullah Financial District and Amaala to create significant demand. - Further growth can be expected if NWC decides to install water meter in every households ( Currently in many cases water meter are installed at a building level).

Description of Investment Opportunity National Additive Manufacturing & Innovation Company (NAMI), a joint venture between 3D Systems Corporation and Dussur, specializes in first of its kind innovation and 3D printing center.

The opportunity lies in providing a range of post-processing services to enhance the quality, functionality, and performance of manufactured products in Saudi Arabia.

Products/Services covered

Surface finishing
- Sanding, polishing, sand blasting, shot peening, chemical milling, tumbling, electropolishing, abrasive flow machining, painting

Heat treatment
- Stress relief, aging, solution annealing (vacuum HT) for Steels, Ni-alloys, Titanium, Al-alloys

Cleaning
- Ultrasonic cleaning, chemical cleaning, advanced de-powdering

Inspection and quality control
- Dimensional inspection (CMM, optical), non-destructive testing (X-Ray, FPI, DPI), powder flowability & PSD

Assembly and integration
- Final assembly of components, coatings Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 15-20M (USD 4-5.3M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 30-60M (USD 8-16M) Strategic Benefits • Improved product quality and performance
• Reduced manufacturing costs in comparison with outsourcing abroad
• Supporting local manufacturing growth

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists to develop local capabilities for sodium cyanide.

- Potential to collaborate with local industries and waste management facilities to utilize byproducts, creating a circular economy model that minimizes waste and maximizes resource utilization.

- Application: Sodium cyanide, a chemical compound renowned for its role in the mining sector, is indispensable for gold extraction processes. Its ability to form stable complexes with gold allows for efficient separation from ore, enabling extraction methods like cyanidation. 

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals - Sodium Cyanide (Assay solid with 98% purity in cubic form). Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 381M (USD 101.6M)
[Projected for 2024 - 2028] Strategic Benefits • Increases in mining activity would create increased demand for sodium cyanide.
• Resource synergy – Saudi Arabia has abundant petrochemical resources, helping to create a secure and local supply chain for key raw materials required for sodium cyanide production, creating cost-efficiencies and reliability
• Proportional increases in demand with expansion of the mining industry / sector. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - MENA is the biggest importer of Sodium Cyanide. Asia is the biggest exporter. - Ma’aden procures only one type of Sodium Cyanide (Assay solid with 98% purity in cubic form). - Potential to collaborate with Ma’aden, providing essential sodium cyanide for gold extraction.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Manufacture signaling and telecom (S&T) hardware and components.

Manufacturing S&T hardware and components includes manufacturing circuit boards, integrated circuits or chips, antennas used for wireless communication between trains, sensors and power supplies. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 150-225M (USD 40-60M)
[OpEx requirement per annum to deploy a retrofitting team includes electrical and mechanical engineers, welders and fabricators, technicians, and other supporting functions] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 400 – 500M (USD 106.7-133.3M)
[Projected for 2024-2030 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • OEMs utilize similar circuit boards, chips, antennas, and semiconductors across their cross-industrial service portfolio, driving potential for national demand consolidation

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Localizing the production of finished automotive lights to supply to the local OEMs in Saudi Arabia. Products include exterior light for vehicles e.g., headlights, taillights, braking strips and fog lights.
- Automotive-grade lights technology can be used to manufacture lights for other vehicles e.g., bus, trucks.
- This opportunity occurs in tier-1 manufacturing phases, prior to the assembly/distribution. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 110M (USD 29.3M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 400M (USD 106.7M+)
[Projected for 2035 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Meet demand from OEM projects, with proximity to OEMs.
• Develop automotive-grade light manufacturing capabilities in Saudi Arabia.
• Leverage low raw material (plastic) prices in Saudi Arabia.
• Leverage capabilities for other vehicle types (e.g., bus). Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Localization of OEMs production in Saudi Arabia, with confirmed projects by Lucid, Ceer – expected production of 300,000+ vehicles a year. - 17% CAGR estimated for Saudi Arabia demand (mainly from automotive applications). - Increasing regulations regarding the use of effective lightings in automobiles for increased safety. - Increasing demand for premium segment vehicles, with advanced lighting technologies.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: localize assembly of outside plant optical distribution networks (ODNs), which the portion located outside buildings or underground responsible for distributing optical signals from the point of presence to the customer premises. The ODN specifically has five segments: feeder fiber, optical distribution point, distribution fiber, optical access point, and drop fiber.

- Product: ODNs include key passive equipment, such as splitters or fiber distribution cabinets, and are the essential path for PON data transmission.

- Customers: potential key clients include telecoms operators and data center players (for data center networking). Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 400M+ (USD 106.7M+)
[Projected by 2029] Strategic Benefits • Large potential for import substitution (Saudi Arabian demand mostly supplied by foreign producers). Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Increasing local demand in relevant sectors: telecoms operators' fixed network coverage expansion and data center construction. - Localization of spend in optical distribution networks by STC, PIF's Portfolio Company (approximately SAR 400M 5-years' cumulative demand).

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists in building strength in local capability and capacity for bearings, also for bushings, wheels, and related-parts.

- Application: Vital in mining, bearings, bushings, and wheels are mechanical essentials, enabling diverse functions by facilitating smooth movement, reducing friction, and supporting heavy loads. 

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Roller Bearings, Ball Bearings, Drill Jig Bushings, Steel Shoulder, Bushings). Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 188-206M (USD 50.1-54.9M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 468M (USD 124.8M)
[Projected for 2024 - 2028] Strategic Benefits • The global market size for bearings is estimated at USD 48B for 2021, increasing to USD 56B by 2026 (CAGR of 3.4% during period).
• In Saudi Arabia, local demand is supplied via imports, while global firms import and distribute in Saudi Arabia. This prompts a chance for local production to replace imports.
• Saudi Arabia demand for Bearings, Bushings, & Wheels is met through imports with 84% of this demand originating from high-cost countries Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Manufacturing of Aluminum extrusion products for applications in vehicles especially catering to the demand from Saudi Arabia-based OEMs.
- Product mainly include aluminum extrusion structures for EVs  e.g., roof rails, door frames, dashboard frame and supports, profiles for battery frame.
- Manufacturing of aluminum extrusion components can be supplied to tier-1 suppliers or directly to OEMs. This opportunity occurs in tier-2 and tier-1 manufacturing phases, prior to the assembly/distribution. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 130-150M (USD 34.7-40M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 600-700M (USD 160-186.7M)
[Projected for 2035 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Leverage availability of raw material in Saudi Arabia.
• Cater to localization requirements of OEM projects, while fostering high-precision aluminum extrusion capabilities in Saudi Arabia.
• Expand aluminum extrusion capability into other applications (e.g., construction industry). Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Localization of OEMs production in Saudi Arabia, with confirmed projects by Lucid, Ceer – expected production of >300,000 vehicles a year. - Aluminum is considered a favored material for EVs, as it offers value to OEMs in terms of manufacturing costs, weight savings & performance. - Average aluminum content in a light vehicle is expected to increase to 222 kg/ vehicle by 2030. - 17% CAGR estimated for Saudi Arabia demand (mainly from automotive applications).

Description of Investment Opportunity - Manufacturing of carpets and acoustic systems for light vehicle applications, to be used for car interior/ hood/ underbody/ trunk.
- Acoustic/ insulation systems for OEM/ Tier-1 requirements e.g., car headliner, trunk, door trim, e-motor, battery, wheel encapsulation, instrument panel, center console.
- This opportunity occurs in tier-1 and tier-2 manufacturing phases, prior to the assembly/distribution with potential production opportunity for aftersales market. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 80-100M (USD 21.3-26.7M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 700-800M (USD 186.7-213.3M)
[Projected for 2035 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Cater to localization requirements of OEM projects.
• Leverage low raw material (plastic, fibers) prices in Saudi Arabia.
• Potentially expand into other vehicle segments and consumer goods. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Localization of OEMs production in Saudi Arabia, with confirmed projects by Lucid, Ceer – expected production of >300,000 vehicles a year. - Rising demand for vehicle carpet customization (color, texture, and design). - Increasing use of high-quality, scratch-resistant material for floor carpets. - Increasing demand for enhanced comfort and safety features (e.g., material that allows noise levels to remain within permissible limits).

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists to establish a new local pumps and compressors facility to supply multiple Saudi markets and industries.

- Application: Pumps are a vital mechanical tools utilized in the mining industry that propel liquids or gases through mechanical means. They play a crucial role in tasks such as fluid transport & enhancing operational efficiency.

- Products/Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Pumps). Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 120M (USD 32M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 775M (USD 206.6M)
[Projected for 2024 - 2028] Strategic Benefits • Gain new market share in a continuously evolving and expanding market.
• Steady demand from multiple domestic industries that require annual repair & replacement of the pumps. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - The global market is growing at 5% per annum (2021 to 2030), and Saudi Arabia market size demand is growing by 3-5% annually (2018 to 2024). - Local manufacturers supply to 50% of the local demand, with a utilization rate of 85%.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Localize ToS associated services.

ToS associated services may include:
- Database administration services which involve the management, maintenance, and optimization of databases by a team of experts.
- ToS support services which include technical support for ToS systems and software updates. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 900M – 1.1B (USD 240-300M)
[Projected for 2024-2030 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Associated services are outsourced to global players today.
• Potential to expand these services to GCC port operators, since ToS systems deployed in the region are similar to the ones in Saudi Arabia (e.g., Abu Dhabi ports – Master Terminal ToS; Mwani – Navis N4 ToS). Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia to increase port throughput from 9M TEU to 40M TEU by 2030, which results in increased need for ToS associated services to improve efficiency, resulting in higher spend on these services. - Future digitization efforts (i.e., smart ports) are expected to drive data traffic volume growth by ca 26% per annum. - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Kuwait port expansion).

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Deal Structure:
The Project presents an investment opportunity for the private sector to enter into a development agreement to design, build, finance, operate, insure, and maintain a Construction and Staff Village The transaction will be structured as a 32-year deal, with an upfront investment of ~SAR 2-3B required from the private sector for construction

Assets Under Consideration:
- The project will involve development of a ~12,300-bed Construction Village to meet the short-term demand for 2 years in 2024-2026
- The development will then be converted, over a 3-month rolling refurbishment period, to a permanent ~8,500-bed Staff Village to meet the long-term staff accommodation demand for 30 years
- The project will accommodate a portion of the staff expected to be employed Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 2B+ (USD 0.5B+) Strategic Benefits • Captive and exclusive tenant market: hotels / hospitality businesses will use these staff villages on an exclusive basis, therefore de-risking the investment
• Consistent cash flow generation during the construction phase: the construction village will be used by captive contractors’ staff ensuring high utilization and cash flow generation
• NEOM commitment: significant developments are already underway
• Capital efficient investment: opportunity to invest into a unique product with low refurbishment costs to convert into Staff Village, and generating long term cashflows Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Access to NEOM : Opportunity to become a key development and investment partner in developing NEOM, and access subsequent investment opportunities across NEOM - Promising tourism demand: Demand for hotel assets is expected to be very high, as NEOM is planned to be a key tourist attractor for the wider region with its unique offerings and year-round activities

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Description of Investment Opportunity
Establish local manufacturing/ retreading facility specializing in industrial tires for trucks and mobile cranes (e.g., rubber-tired gantry cranes).

Manufacture tires for heavy equipment used in numerous sectors (e.g., maritime sector for container handlers, construction industry for loaders, mining sector for haul trucks), including:
- Tube tires
- Tubeless tires
- Retreading Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 300-400M (USD 80-106.7M)
[For plant capacity of 3 – 4 M unit/annum] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 0.2-0.3B (USD 0.05-0.08B) Strategic Benefits • There are currently no local players in manufacturing tires for heavy equipment
• High expected demand for retreaded tires for heavy equipment, given financial upside to end-user (retreaded tires can endure 75 – 80% of the lifetime of new tires, provided they are well maintained)
• Export potential3 of SAR 400 – 500M annually Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia to increase port throughput from 9M TEU to 40M TEU by 2030 (~20% CAGR), implying increased need for industrial tires, and therefore increased spend on this category - SGP and RSGT plan to increase their cargo-handling capacity by ~2.5x until 2030 - Demand driven by Saudi Vision 2030 projects (e.g., infrastructure related giga-projects)

Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists to source appropriately skilled manpower to serve local Saudi market with a prioritization of Saudi nationals across all sectors and industries in line with Saudization objectives.

- Application: Laboratory services in the mining industry refer to the testing, analysis, and certification of minerals, ores, and other materials used in mining operations.

- Products / Services Targeted: Analytical testing, environmental testing, mineral processing testing, including sample testing, fire assay testing, radioactivity testing. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 69M (USD 18.4M)
[2023 demand] Strategic Benefits • Strong market growth in the next 5 years.
• Growing mining industry as the third pillar of the Saudi economy – with growth in mining comes growth in demand for associated laboratory services. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - The global geochemical services (which encompasses services related to mining) market size was SAR 3.8B in 2021. - The market is projected to grow from SAR 3.8B in 2021 to SAR 5.3B in 2028, equivalent to a CAGR of 4.9% during the 2021 to 2028 period.

Description of Investment Opportunity - Establishment of a manufacturing facility for freight wagons.
- Proposed facility must be certified by AAR, and wagons must have a fatigue life of 5M km and designed for 32.5T axle load. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 200-250M (USD 53.3-66.7M)
[For plant capacity of 100 wagons monthly] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 3-4B (USD 0.8-1.1B)
[Projected for 2024 - 2030] Strategic Benefits • Significant KSA and regional demand for rolling stock with no local manufacturing capability.
• No / limited local and regional manufacturers for freight wagons, and demand is expected to grow in the region. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by ~2.5x (to 13,000 km of track) and increase its freight volumes by 8x until 2030, resulting in additional need for wagons, increasing spend in this category. - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network). - GCC cumulative freight wagon demand of SAR 27B between 2023 and 2043.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establish a local UTEX providing a comprehensive inventory of spare parts, increasing availability.

A UTEX allows a defective part in the rail sector to be replaced in a few days, while it gets repaired to new condition and goes into UTEX inventory. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 90 -110M (USD 24-29.3M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1-1.2B (USD 0.27-0.32B)
Projected for 2024-2030 across Saudi Arabia Strategic Benefits • Saudi-based UTEX will be well-positioned to cater to the broader GCC rolling stock spares market.
• Export potential of SAR 100 – 150 M annually.
• Opportunity to replace imports of new spare parts to Saudi Arabia. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by 2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), increase passenger volume by 10x, and increase freight volumes by 8x by 2030, which results in increasing use for spare parts, and therefore increasing maintenance, repairs and operations spend. - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network).

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists to invest in capability within Saudi Arabia to counter the strong foreign supply to Saudi Arabia.

- Application: Pitch is used in electrode production in the aluminum  industry.

- Products / Services Targeted: Liquid pitch manufacturing facility. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 168M (USD 44.8M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1.122B (USD 0.3B)
[Projected for 2024 - 2028] Strategic Benefits • Resource availability – abundant access to petroleum resources, a primary source for producing liquid pitch. Leveraging local resources ensures a stable supply chain and has cost advantages.
• Potential to position liquid pitch manufacturing facility strategically to supply neighboring countries in the Gulf region. Saudi Arabia's geographical proximity and connectivity enhances export potential. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Global liquid pitch market estimated at SAR 13.1B in 2020, expected to reach SAR 19.1B by 2027 registering a CAGR of 5.4%. - Demand for pitch is driven by end use industries such as aluminum and Steel, both of which are growing in Saudi Arabia.

Description of Investment Opportunity - Establishment of a manufacturing facility to produce running gear spare parts, i.e., wheelsets and axles.
- Wheels should be built through forging process, with an average wheel life of 200,000 km in KSA climate conditions. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 70-100M (USD 18.7-26.7M)
[For plant capacity of ~25k wheelsets annually] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 300-500M (USD 80-133.3M)
[Projected for 2024 - 2030] Strategic Benefits • Only 1% of SAR’s spare part stock value is KSA-made.
• Steel wheels account for 30-50% of annual running gear OPEX spend at SAR.
• Export potential of SAR 100 – 150 M annually. short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists to meet Ma’aden’s demand through domestically manufactured products, Establish local manufacturing capability for Caskets & Steals.

- A gasket fills the space between two or more mating surfaces to prevent leakage from the joined objects while under compression. Category scope includes gaskets, bushing and their sub types.

- Ma’aden’s existing gasket demand is currently split between in country and foreign suppliers, opportunity exists to more fully meet Ma’aden’s demand through domestically manufactured products.
- Value chain: Gaskets can mainly be found Inside process equipment like pumps and compressors or outside process equipment like flanges.

- Application: Gaskets are mechanical components used in the mining industry to seal joints and prevent leaks. Seals are mechanical components used in the mining industry to prevent the leakage of fluids, gases, and other substances.  

- Products / Services Targeted: Gaskets, spiral wound, pre-cut, jacketed, ring joint, camprofile. seals, mechanical, Labyrinth. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 26-34M (USD 6.9-9.1M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 251M (USD 66.9M)
[Projected for 2024 - 2028] Strategic Benefits • Middle East Gaskets & Seals Market expected to account for $6.87bn by 2028. This equates to a CAGR of 5% over the forecast period Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establish a manufacturing facility for spare parts for cargo handling equipment, with the potential to expand into components for other heavy vehicles such as trucks and prime movers.
Manufacture components such as:

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Establish a manufacturing facility for maintenance supplies and consumables
- Manufacture a wide range of materials including:
a. Spreaders (e.g., wedge plates, splitter arms, drag chains) (replacement rate of 8,000 – 12,000 hours of operations)
b. Wire ropes (e.g., main hoist, carbon ropes) (replacement rate of 8,000 – 12,000 hours of operations)
c. Filters (e.g., air filters, oil filters, fuel filters) (replacement rate of 3,000 – 5,000 hours of operations)
d. Cables (e.g., connectors, festoon cables, brake drums) (replacement rate of 5,000 – 10,000 hours of operations)
e. Brakes (e.g., brake hoists, brake hose, brake drums) (replacement rate of 6,000 – 8,000 hours of operations) Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 100-150M (USD 26.7-40M)
[For plant capacity of ~800M units/annum] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1.2-1.4B (USD 0.3-0.4B)
[Projected for 2024 - 2030] Strategic Benefits Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia to increase port throughput from 9M TEU to 40M TEU by 2030 (~20% CAGR), resulting in additional demand of maintenance supplies, and therefore increased spend on these materials. SGP and RSGT (PIF owned terminal operators) plan to increase their cargo handling capacity by ~2.5x until 2030. - Saudi National Transport & Logistics maritime strategy has set an objective to increase annual GDP contribution to SAR 55 – 65B by 2030. - Saudi industrial sector GDP to increase by 3x by 2030.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Localize manufacturing of rail bars, including welds and joints.
- Manufacturing rail bars entails establishing domestic production facilities equipped with advanced processes like steel rolling, welding and heat treatment. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 200-300M (USD 53.3-80M)
[For plant capacity of 450,000 tones/annum] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 17-19B (USD 4.5-5.1B)
[Projected for 2024 - 2030] Strategic Benefits • Currently no local rail-steel grade manufacturing capabilities – SAR 500M, 260 kt imports in 2018 (peak imports over past five years).
• Recurring rail bar demand due to replacements during maintenance.
• Export potential of SAR 120 – 160 M annually. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by ~2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), resulting in additional rail bars in Kingdom, increasing spend on this category. - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network).

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Set up a manufacturing plant for maintenance supplies and consumables.

Manufacture a wide range of maintenance supplies, to be used in numerous sectors, including the rail sector (infrastructure materials, such as nuts, washers, bolts and screws). Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 100-150M (USD 26.7-40M)
[For plant capacity of ~800 M units/annum] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ​SAR 200-300M (USD 53.3-80M)
[Projected for 2024-2030 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Absence of local suppliers for high-volume MRO materials
• Targeted components have standardized specifications with cross-industrial applications (i.e., maritime, aviation)
• Export potential of SAR 3 – 4 M annually
• Potential to become supplier of choice for Saudi rail operators, given current global supplier lead-time is eight months (e.g., CRRC, WABTEC) Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by 2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), increase passenger volume by 10x, and increase freight volumes by 8x by 2030, leading to an increase in the usage of maintenance supplies, and therefore increasing the spend on these materials - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network)

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists to address current market and take advantage of growing demand to establish strong local manufacturing capability.

- Application: In the mining sector, filtration components and machinery are paramount for maintaining product quality and safeguarding equipment against detrimental contaminants. By effectively removing impurities and particulates, these systems contribute to smoother operations.

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Filtration components and machinery). Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 165M (USD 44M)
[Projected for 2024 - 2028] Strategic Benefits • Growing need for treated water and for desalinated water to supply surging demand – Saudi Arabia filtration market expected to grow to SAR 375M
• Local manufacturing of filtration equipment in Saudi Arabia around 40% of the total supply volume in the market – presence of assembly activities in Saudi Arabia. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Potential for 100% private investment with an opportunity for organic growth or partnerships. - Similar growth observed in neighboring countries, thus opening the filtration market beyond Saudi Arabia.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists to develop strong local capability in this area, providing valves and blocks supply for many sectors.

- Application: Valves and blocks are vital for fluid and gas control in piping systems. In mining, valves regulate flow and pressure, aiding substance management, while blocks strategically redirect fluid paths, enhancing system performance and integrity.

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Valves & Blocks). Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 90M (USD 24M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 614M (USD 163.7M)
[Projected for 2024 - 2028] Strategic Benefits • Giga-projects planned/initiated in Saudi Arabia to drive demand for valves in both industrial and commercial segments over next 10 – 15 years.
• Sector opportunities include catering demand by company as well as contractors in the region. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - The Saudi market size (2021) is SAR 5.4B growing by 7% annually to become SAR 10.3B by 2030. - Easy access to high growth industrial valves market – GCC projected to grow at 3.1% p.a.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity The aviation industry is undergoing a significant transformation, with airlines modernizing their fleets and retiring older aircraft at an accelerating pace.

This has created an opportunity to establish a state-of-the-art aircraft recycling hub dedicated to the aerospace industry with a melting capability to produce raw material and a recycled spare parts facility.

The facility would serve not only local but also regional airlines. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 100-150M (USD 26.7-40M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 800-850M (USD 213.3-226.7M) Strategic Benefits • There is a growing trend towards retiring older aircrafts due to up to 40% higher fuel consumption
• The opportunity also aligns with Saudi Green Initiative by promoting sustainable industrial practices, reducing waste, and cutting carbon emissions. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers The airline operators in the region are estimated to experience a demand for around 2,900 new aircraft over the next 20 years, increasing the retirement of older aircrafts The Middle East market is growing at CAGR of 3.3% and is expected to be SAR 800-850M by 2030

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Specifications:
1. Gate Valve - Air Valve - Butterfly Valve - Ball Valve1 - Control Valve.
2. Setting up a valve manufacturing plant to cater water and wastewater sector requirements across the local and regional markets.

Key products (HS code): 
-Butterfly valve (84818010)
-Gate valves (84818090) 
-Other valves such as air valves, etc. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg Approx.SAR 50-80M (~USD 13.3-21.3M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 3.3B (USD 0.9B)
[Forecasted up to 2030] Strategic Benefits • The Saudi water sector and NWC represent key demand centers for valves . Valves manufacturing is part of the Saudi Arabian National Industrial Strategy.
• Localization of valve manufacturing aimed at 45% by 2030, up from ~18% in 2021. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Valves market is set to grow at 7% CAGR reaching the size of ~ SAR 11.3 Bn by 2030 driven by O&G, construction, and infrastructure expansion plans. - Planned 1,400+ water distribution projects, worth nearly SAR 124 Bn and SAR 11 Bn worth of investments in wastewater reuse expected from National Water Company (2021 – 26). - 3500+ km of additional water transmission lines expected to be added by The Water Transmission and Technologies Company. - MEWA allocated SAR 150 Bn for water projects under five-year capital portfolio of environment, water & agriculture systems. - Projects such as NEOM, the Red Sea Project, Qiddiya Entertainment City, King Abdullah Financial District and Amaala to create significant demand.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more uPVC door and window systems fabrication plants to address the local supply gap of 1.4-2.0M units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of uPVC profiles, glass panes, and accessories to fabricate the final product 
- Automation of large-scale assembly lines to competitively fulfil large orders
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities to extrude uPVC profiles Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 90-110M (USD 24-29.3M)
[For a facility of 100K units per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 52B (~USD 13.9B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to substitute imports of uPVC doors and windows (~SAR 160M in 2022)
• Abundant availability of uPVC resin in Saudi Arabia from SABIC (through SAPPCO), a key local supplier of uPVC resin with production plants in Riyadh and Dammam
• Large production volumes allowing for automation, resulting in EBITDA margins of ~20% in line with global leaders Current Market Characteristics • Consolidated local market with three players holding ~60% share; rest addressed by small players and imports, mostly from China and Turkey
• Key local players
• Wintek SA and Fazah Group have capability to locally extrude uPVC profiles with European standards, and Creative Windows Co,, which importing uPVC profiles from Germany
• Local suppliers of input material: Wintek (extrusions), Fazah (extrusions), AGC Obeikan (glass), Uniglass (glass), and Guardian Glass (glass) Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative national demand 32M uPVC units for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more wood plastic composite (WPC) doors fabrication plants to address the local supply gap of 780,000-1,000,000 units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of components such as door frame, structure, body, and accessories as per the specifications of a certified or in-house system design
- Inclusion of capabilities to produce WPC cabinetry and cladding Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 50-70M (USD 13.3-18.7M)
[For a facility of 100K units per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 44B (~USD 11.7B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to replace imports of WPC products to Saudi Arabia (~SAR 100M in 2022)
• Abundant local availability of plastic resin, one of the key input materials for WPC Current Market Characteristics • Growing market, with several developers in Saudi Arabia already adopting WPC doors as a substitute for wood doors in residential projects (e.g., RAFAL, Almajdiah Residence, Sahel Real Estate Co.)
• Only 2 local producers in Saudi Arabia: Alfadoors and Ablaze
• Local suppliers of input material: Plastic resin from players such as SABIC, Saudi Industrial Resins Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative national demand of 18M units of WPC doors for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more fixed fire detector systems assembly plants to address the local supply gap of 6-8M units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of heat, smoke, and gas detector systems for commercial and residential applications
- Potential to produce some components in-factory (e.g., external body, electrical wiring) Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 20 - 30M (USD 5.3-8M)
[For a facility of 200K units per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 46B (USD 12.3B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to replace imports of fixed fire detector systems (~SAR 215M in 2022)
• Local demand for fire detector systems is currently supplied solely through imports; potential first-mover advantage
• Local availability of raw materials for production of external body, electrical wiring
• Export potential to cater to annual demand of over 1M units per annum (~SAR 400M) in rest of GCC (excluding Saudi Arabia) Current Market Characteristics • Market for fixed detector systems is supplied through imports mainly from US and Europe
• There is no production facility in Saudi Arabia, or in the GCC region
• Local suppliers of input components
• Ma’aden (aluminum and copper), SABIC (plastic resin) Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative national demand of ~114M units of fixed detector systems for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more epoxy flooring coatings production plants to address the local supply gap of 80,000-86,000 tons per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Focus on residential and commercial segments, but have capability to also supply to the industrial segment
- Inclusion of a wide portfolio of visually appealing designs to drive customer adoption Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 30-40M (USD 8-10.7M)
[For a facility of 20 ktpa capacity; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 38B (USD B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to replace imports of epoxy coatings to Saudi Arabia (SAR 215M in 2022)
• Abundant local availability of key raw materials such as propylene and bisphenol A
• Opportunity to export to the wider GCC region, given limited regional manufacturers and high dependence on imports Current Market Characteristics • Epoxy coatings are primarily used in industrial floorings in Saudi Arabia; there are no local producers of epoxy coatings for the residential and commercial segment
• JANA is the only local producer, currently supplying to the industrial segment only
• Local suppliers of input material: Raw materials such as propylene and bisphenol A are available from suppliers such as SABIC, Saudi Kayan Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative national demand ~1M tons of epoxy floor coatings for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more door locks manufacturing plants to address the local supply gap of 6.3-8.2M locks per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Focus on production of locks for residential doors – both new doors and after sales/ replacement market; large upcoming local demand for residential doors (~98M units from 2025 to 2040)
- Inclusion of capability to produce the sub-components within the facility (e.g., cylinders, bolts, springs) Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 30-60M (USD 8-16M)
[For a facility of 1-2M units per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 46B (~USD 12.3B)
Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to replace imports of door locks (~SAR 400M in 2022)
• Export potential to cater to a market demand of more thn SAR 600M (10-12M units) in GCC (excluding Saudi Arabia)
• Cost competitiveness of local production due to lower logistics cost and avoidance of 15% import tariffs
• Local procurement preference in contracts (e.g., price preference, local content consideration in commercial evaluation) Current Market Characteristics • Market supplied solely through imports, of which 47% comes from China, 36% from Europe (Italy 22%, Germany 7%, Spain 6%, Greece 2%), and 5% from the US
• International players
• AssaAbloy ,Yale, and Schlage

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more concrete formwork systems manufacturing plants to address the local supply gap of 2.5-3.5M tons per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Production of steel-based high-specification concrete formwork systems (e.g., for high-rises, bridges, tunnels)
- Inclusion of capabilities to supervise and certify full formwork system assembly on-site Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 110-130M (USD 29.3-34.7M)
[For a facility of 100 ktpa capacity; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 129B (~USD 34.4B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to replace imports covering >80% of demand of medium- to high spec formwork products
• Local availability of steel raw materials, contributing 70-80% of material cost
• 40-60% reduction in logistics and transportation costs to serve customers in Saudi Arabia, leading to 1-2% reduction in overall operating costs
• Local procurement preference in contracts (e.g., price preference, local content consideration in commercial evaluation) Current Market Characteristics • Local players serve low- and some medium-spec segments; global players serve the majority of medium- to high-spec segment
• Players
• Local: Saudi Scaffolding Company, Al Sandan, United Steel, Manar Al Omran, and Attieh-Ulma (JV between ULMA [Spain] and Attieh Group [local])
• Global: include Doka (Austria), PERI (Germany), RMD Kwikform (UAE), Acrow (Turkey), TECON (China)
• Local suppliers of input materials
• Zamil, Al Rajhi, Al Ittefaq, Bahra for steel Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative demand of SAR 52M tons for medium- to high-spec formwork systems in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more scroll compressors and motors assembly plants (separately) to address the local supply gap of ~5M scroll compressors and ~18M motors per annum used in HVAC systems

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of scroll compressors includes having automation and robotics for mass production
- Motors facility includes having automated assembly lines for 3 types of motors: blower, swing and condenser fan motors Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 0.8-1.0B (USD 0.2-0.3B)
[For a facility of 2M compressors and 8M motors per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 112B (~USD 29.9B)
Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia Strategic Benefits • Opportunity to close gap in HVAC supply chain, as currently all compressors and motors are imported
• Significant potential to expand to other industries with high demand for compressors and motors such as automotive, oil and gas, water desalination and petrochemicals
• Ability to benefit from the “Standard Incentives Program” and receive funding up to 35% of the initial capex (capped at SAR 50M)
• Current Market
• Market fully supplied through imports; no local producer of compressors and motors
• Key global players include Gree (China), Mitsubishi Electric (Japan) and Danfoss (Denmark) Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative demand of ~86M units scroll compressors and ~288M units of motors in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of LED modules, electronic drivers, and non-electronic components
- Focus on premium-grade lighting fixtures for commercial and residential applications 
- Potential inclusion of in-factory production of non-electronic components (e.g., body, diffuser, reflector) Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 50-100M (USD 13.3-26.7M)

[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Local supply catering standard and mid-grade segments; premium segments are currently being imported
• Local availability of raw materials for production of non-electronic components4 (contributing 40-60% of material cost)
• Increasing regulatory standards (e.g., power consumption, heat dissipation, lamp lifetime) driving shift toward high-performance fixtures Current Market Characteristics • Market for premium lighting fixtures is supplied through imports mainly from Europe
• Key local players
• SLC, Al Babtain, Noortek, National Lighting Co., Alfanar, and Al Adwaa are focused on mid-grade and standard-grade lighting fixtures

Description of Investment Opportunity - Saudi Coffee Company has launched its brand ‘Jazean’ with the aim of becoming the leader and global custodian of Arabica coffee production and marketing
- An opportunity exists to enable green coffee import and re-export to key markets to supplement local production and strengthen Saudi Arabia’s role in the international coffee market
- The private sector is expected to localize key capabilities in green coffee import and re-export, including but not limited to developing specialized warehousing, optimizing logistics for bulk coffee handling, and localizing export-oriented processing facilities Key opportunity characteristics Strategic Benefits • Local manufacturing of coffee beans is aligned with Vision 2030 by diversifying non-oil revenues
• Lower cost as compared to importing coffee beans
• Access to the largest market in the Middle East Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - The Middle East coffee market is valued at $175 million (2025) and is expected to reach $290 million with a CAGR of 10.61%

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Specifications:
1. Setting up a flow meter assembly unit to supply key industries (Water, O&G, etc.) across the local and regional markets. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 50-60M (~USD 13.3-16M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 121M (USD 32.3M)
[Forecasted upto 2030] Strategic Benefits • High potential of localization of flowmeter manufacturing as local sourcing of flow meter components and material available in KSA. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia flow meter expected to grow by 5% CAGR until 2027 primarily driven by shift towards reducing non-revenue water in distribution and transmission. - Planned 1,400+ water distribution projects worth SAR 124 Bn by National Water Company. - MEWA water sector expansion program launched on Aug 2022 to control and reduce the Non-Revenue Water Percentage for Transmission and distribution systems. - 3500+km of additional water transmission lines required by National Water Company and The Water Transmission and Technologies Company. - A good proportion of market is also occupied by the service sector for the calibration and maintenance of flow meters.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Specifications:
1. Setting up a centrifugal pumps manufacturing plant to cater water and wastewater sector requirements across the local and regional markets.

Key products (HS code):
-Pumps, for liquids (841319)
-Centrifugal Pumps (841370)
-Pumps, parts (841391) Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 150-180M (~USD 40-48M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1.9B (USD 0.5B)
[Forecasted up to 2030] Strategic Benefits • High potential due to localization of pump manufacturing at ~22% in 2021.
• Pumps is part of the Saudi Arabian National Industrial Strategy. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia Centrifugal Pump and Service & Spare Parts market size is projected to grow at CAGR of 4.5% (2021-2030) driven by O&G, chemicals and infrastructure expansion plans.  - Planned 1,400+ water distribution projects, worth nearly SAR 124 Bn and SAR 11 Bn worth of investments in wastewater reuse expected from National Water Company (2021 – 26).  - 3500+ km of additional water transmission lines expected to be added by The Water Transmission and Technologies Company.  - Projects such as NEOM, the Red Sea Project, Qiddiya Entertainment City, King Abdullah Financial District and Amaala to create significant demand.  - Periodic replacement of pump seals, bearings, seal housings and shaft sleeves in existing projects across relevant industries constitutes a demand driver.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more wood doors fabrication plants to address the local supply gap of 3.5-5M doors per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Processing of wood to produce hollow-core and solid-core doors for residential projects
- Automation of assembly lines to competitively fulfill large orders
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 100-150M (USD 26.7-40M)
[For a facility of 200K units per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 147B (~USD 39.2B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Favorable competitive environment due to absence of local at-scale suppliers to fulfill large demand orders
• Potential for horizontal expansion to adjacent wood products (e.g., cumulative demand from 2025 to 2040 for wood cabinetry products from PIF projects > SAR 4B)
• Large production volumes allowing for automation, resulting in EBITDA margins higher than local competition, with estimated EBITDA margin of 9-14% for medium-sized players and less than 5% for small players Current Market Characteristics • Highly fragmented, consisting mostly of small to medium-sized players, with production inefficiencies(low capacity and higher cost per unit compared to doors produced in automated lines)
• Local players
• Alfa Wood, Bin Laden Wood Factory, MWP Co., Othman Wood (non-exhaustive)
• Local suppliers of input materials
• Major components (e.g., fiberboards, solid wood, accessories, and locks) are imported Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative national demand ~98M residential doors units (~SAR 147B) for the 2025-2040 period, with largest residential doors segment is wood, representing 75%-85% of existing doors - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

- Automation of large-scale assembly lines to competitively fulfil large sized orders

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Badael is a pioneer in enhancing the quality of life through innovative and sustainable solutions. Committed to Saudi Vision 2030, Badael is dedicated to helping one million Saudis quit smoking by 2028.

To support this mission, Badael has launched its flagship product, DZRT, nicotine pouches that offer a less harmful, tobacco-free alternative to help individuals quit smoking.

An opportunity exists to establish a local manufacturing facility for pure nicotine, which would supply both Badael and global markets.

Application
Pure nicotine serves as the core active ingredient in nicotine pouches, delivering a controlled nicotine dose to satisfy cravings without the harmful chemicals found in traditional tobacco products. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 14-46M (USD 3.7-12.3M) Strategic Benefits • Enhanced focus on Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Tobacco Control Strategy, aimed at improving the quality of life by promoting a smoke-free environment.
• Gain access to the largest market in the Middle East, with a rapidly growing population projected to reach 39.7 million by 2030.
• Limited local supply and the potential to export to regional markets. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - The global nicotine pouch market is valued at $3.95 billion and is expected to reach $22.95 billion, registering a CAGR of 34.4%. - In Saudi Arabia, the market is currently valued at SAR 900 million and is expected to grow at a CAGR of 30%.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Establishing one or more polyether monomer production plants to address the local supply gap of 9,000-12,000 tons per annum
- Focus on producing T-shaped isopentyl polyethylene glycol (TPEG) and methoxy polyethylene glycol (MPEG) monomers to cater to demand driven by PCE producers Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 700-800M (USD 186.7-213.3M)
[For a facility of 45 ktpa capacity; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1B (USD 0.3B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Absence of local production of polyether monomers
• Local availability of raw materials required for manufacturing polyether monomers (ethylene oxide, isobutylene, methanol, formaldehyde) at a significant cost advantage compared with global competitors
• Potential upside from demand from developing pharmaceutical industry in Saudi Arabia; globally, 80% of polyether monomer demand originates from the pharma industry
• Growing PCE use in other GCC countries will lead to additional demand of 16,000-24,000 tons of polyether monomers per annum; no polyether monomer producers present in other GCC countries
• Current Market
• Polyether monomers are synthesized by global chemicals companies such as Fengchen, BASF, Dow Chemical, Lotte Chemicals, and INEOS in locations including China, Europe, US, South Korea
• Local suppliers of input chemicals: Sadara, Saudi Kayan, Saudi Yanbu Petrochemical Company, Saudi European Petrochemical Company, Aramco Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative Saudi Arabia polyether monomer demand from concrete admixtures only of ~167,000 tons (~ SAR 1B) for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by the need for PCE-based concrete admixtures in PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity Establishing one or more production facilities to manufacture batch mixers to address the local supply gap of 75-110 units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Processing of steel, alloy casting and plastic to produce mixer components
- Focus on supplying to the batch plants mixers replacement market
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 50-60M (USD 13.3-16M)
[For a facility of 75-100K units per year; excluding land cost] /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 117M (~USD 31.2M)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Absence of local production of batch plant mixers
• Local availability of raw materials required for manufacturing the mixer components (steel, alloy casting, and plastic)
• Large export potential to cater to a demand of ~300 units per annum (~SAR 150M) in GCC countries (excluding Saudi Arabia) Current Market Characteristics • Market supplied solely through imports, of which 70% comes from Europe, 20% from China
• Sicoma (Italy), Liebherr (Switzerland), BHS-Sonthofen (Germany) Key Growth Drivers - Demand for batch plant mixers driven by replacement requirements across Saudi Arabia batch plants fulfilling large concrete demand by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

short_description.raw: مزايدة تقديم الخدمات الغذائية والعامة ( مطاعم ومتاجر عامة) إضافة "مزايدة تقديم الخدمات الغذائية والعامة ( مطاعم ومتاجر عامة ) بمباني كليات الجامعة". موعد التقديم : يوم الخميس تاريخ 2024/12/19م موعد نهاية تقديم العطاء : يوم الاربعاء تاريخ 2025/01/22م موعد فتح المظاريف : يوم الخميس 2025/01/23م. قيمة الكراسة: 300 ريال     مميزات الفرصة: 1- مدة العقد لمدة ٣ سنوات الشروط تفتح المظاريف الساعة العاشرة والنصف صباحاً بمكتب سعادة مدير عام الإدارة العامة للشؤون الإدارية والمالية بمبنى الإدارة الرئيسي رقم (3) بالدور الثالث. مراجعة إدارة المشتريات والمناقصات للحصول على كراسة الشروط والمواصفات وسداد القيمة عن طريق البنك (نقداً أو شيك مصدق باسم جامعة الملك فيصل). يشترط شراء الكراسة لتقديم العطاء. يشترط تقديم سند الشراء عند تقديم العطاء. شراء الكراسة وتقديم العطاءات يتم عن طريق إدارة المشتريات بمبنى إدارة الجامعة. للاستفسار: يمكن التواصل مع إدارة الاستثمار وتنمية الموارد أو هاتف ( 0135897755 ) للاطلاع على النسخة العامة من كراسة الشروط و المواصفات الرجاء الضغط على الرابط الأسفل :- كراسة الشروط و المواصفات
